faqs.question: What formats do you deliver for social media posts?
faqs.answer: We deliver square (1:1), portrait feed (4:5), and full-screen vertical stories/reels (9:16) in high-resolution PNG, JPG, MP4, and master Figma files.

faqs.question: Can you design templates our internal team can edit?
faqs.answer: Yes, we create fully organized, locked-layer Figma templates with text styles and auto-layout so your team can easily update copy.
